description: This file defines the ProductOptionValueService interface, which provides methods for managing product option values within a catalog, including CRUD operations and retrieval by various criteria.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueService
classes.description: Interface for managing product option values, extending generic entity service for CRUD operations.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option value or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves product option values by their name within a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a product option value by its unique ID within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all product option values associated with a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Lists all product option values associated with a store, excluding read-only entries.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option value by its code within a store.
